# CI runner image fixtures

These files define the intended boundary in [decision 0014](../../../docs/decisions/0014-ci-images-detector.md), especially [“What the detector reads and judges”](../../../docs/decisions/0014-ci-images-detector.md#what-the-detector-reads-and-judges), [“What is dynamic, and what happens to it”](../../../docs/decisions/0014-ci-images-detector.md#what-is-dynamic-and-what-happens-to-it), and [“Examples for the fixture task”](../../../docs/decisions/0014-ci-images-detector.md#examples-for-the-fixture-task). Line numbers below are 1-based. The plausible image tags exercise parsing boundaries. “Judged (reviewed rule needed)” means the declaration can be matched only if a reviewed rule has official evidence. A label with no such rule is not a lifecycle finding.

| Fixture file | Expected case |
| --- | --- |
| `positive/.gitlab-ci.yml` | Root `image` at line 1, service string at line 4, service object `name` at line 5, and job `image` at line 8 are **parsed, unclassified** (GitLab not judged in this version; decision 0014, “What the detector reads and judges” and “Rules and evidence”). No lifecycle finding. |
| `positive/.circleci/config.yml` | Orb reference at line 3 is **parsed, unclassified** (orb contents are not resolved; decision 0014, “What the detector reads and judges”). Job `docker.image` line 7, job `machine.image` line 12, executor `docker.image` line 18, and executor `machine.image` line 21 are **judged (reviewed rule needed)** (decision 0014, “Rules and evidence”). These values are parser examples only, not retirement claims. |
| `positive/azure-pipelines.yml` | Pipeline `pool.vmImage` `ubuntu-20.04` at line 2 and stage `pool.vmImage` `windows-2019` at line 7 match curated removal rules. Job `pool.vmImage` `macOS-12` at line 11 is **judged (reviewed rule needed)** and produces no finding, because no reviewed rule covers it (decision 0014, “What the detector reads and judges” and “Rules and evidence”). |
| `negative/.gitlab-ci.yml` | Comment line 1, `description` line 7, `displayName` line 8, `resource_class` line 9, and image-looking variable `IMAGE_LABEL` line 10 are **ignored (nothing returned)** (decision 0014, “What the detector reads and judges” and “What is dynamic, and what happens to it”). `image: $IMAGE` line 2 and service `${IMAGE}` line 4 are **parsed, unclassified** (dynamic; decision 0014, “What is dynamic, and what happens to it”). Service `name: latest` line 5 is **parsed, unclassified** (floating; same section). Non-string job `image` line 12 is **ignored (nothing returned)** (decision 0014, same section). |
| `negative/.circleci/config.yml` | Orb reference line 3 is **parsed, unclassified** (orb not resolved; decision 0014, “What the detector reads and judges”). Orb-only executor line 6, unrelated `description` line 10, `resource_class` line 20, and non-string image line 19 are **ignored (nothing returned)** (decision 0014, “What the detector reads and judges” and “What is dynamic, and what happens to it”). Dynamic image values at lines 12–16 and 23 are **parsed, unclassified** (dynamic; decision 0014, “What is dynamic, and what happens to it”). Floating image values at lines 17–18 are **parsed, unclassified** (floating; same section). |
| `negative/.circleci/unresolved-alias.yml` | Parser-level fixture only; the detector does not read this filename. Unresolved alias at line 5 is **ignored (nothing returned)** because the parser does not resolve YAML aliases (decision 0014, “What is dynamic, and what happens to it”). |
| `negative/azure-pipelines.yml` | Comment line 1, root `name` line 2, pool `name` line 4, unrelated variable keys lines 6–8, `displayName` line 15, and `resource_class` line 16 are **ignored (nothing returned)** (decision 0014, “What the detector reads and judges” and “What is dynamic, and what happens to it”). Dynamic job-level `pool.vmImage` values at lines 12 and 19 are **parsed, unclassified** (dynamic; decision 0014, “What is dynamic, and what happens to it”). Floating job-level `pool.vmImage` values at lines 22 and 25 are **parsed, unclassified** (floating; same section). |
| `zero/.gitlab-ci.yml` | Root image line 1, service value line 3, and job image line 5 are **parsed, unclassified** (GitLab not judged; decision 0014, “What the detector reads and judges”). Valid file; no lifecycle findings. |
| `zero/.circleci/config.yml` | `docker.image` line 5 is **parsed, unclassified** (floating `current` alias; decision 0014, “What is dynamic, and what happens to it”). Valid file; no lifecycle findings. |
| `zero/azure-pipelines.yml` | Pipeline `pool.vmImage` line 2 is **parsed, unclassified** (floating `ubuntu-latest` alias; decision 0014, “What is dynamic, and what happens to it”). Valid file; no lifecycle findings. |
| `malformed/.gitlab-ci.yml` | Truncated sequence at line 5 makes the document malformed; **ignored (nothing returned)**, including the otherwise image-looking line 1 (decision 0014, “What is dynamic, and what happens to it”). |
| `malformed/.circleci/config.yml` | Unterminated flow sequence at line 2 makes the document malformed; **ignored (nothing returned)** (decision 0014, “What is dynamic, and what happens to it”). |
| `malformed/azure-pipelines.yml` | Unterminated flow mapping at line 1 makes the document malformed; **ignored (nothing returned)** (decision 0014, “What is dynamic, and what happens to it”). |

The zero fixtures are valid, contain only floating/current-style image values, and should have no lifecycle findings. Unclassified references are not findings. Malformed fixtures should be handled without an error or partial declaration results.
